text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Lady Tsuru-chan~. Happy birthday to you.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yay! Thank you very much, Bright-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'm so very happy to be able to celebrate 
this day with you~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...How nostalgic~. That day I went to 
deliver celebratory flowers all the way to 
your hospital room.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Things like that did happen back then, 
didn't they... I'm sorry for worrying you 
so much at the time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
No, that was a fun time as well~. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Since we share a room, I get to be the 
very first to congratulate you. I am truly 
so happy right now~

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Bright-san... I'm feeling so happy right 
now too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us celebrate to your heart's 
content. I have prepared enough black tea 
and tea snacks for half a year, after 
all~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes, of cour— A half-year's worth?!
